description: About This Role We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help define how our products are positioned, launched, and adopted in the market. This role sits at the intersection of product, sales, and marketing, with a clear focus on translating customer and market insights into effective go-to-market execution. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to shape messaging, enable sales teams, and support revenue growth across the product lifecycle. This is an execution-heavy role suited for someone who is comfortable working with data, customers, and internal stakeholders in a fast-moving SaaS environment. What You’ll Do Customer & Market Insights Engage with customers and prospects to gather qualitative and quantitative insights. Translate customer needs and feedback into clear positioning and messaging inputs. Analyze the competitive landscape to identify gaps, opportunities, and differentiation. Go-to-Market & Positioning Define and execute go-to-market strategies aligned with business priorities. Shape product positioning and narratives that support adoption and growth. Partner with product and marketing teams to support product launches and feature rollouts. Sales Enablement Build sales playbooks, enablement materials, and core marketing assets. Partner with sales teams to refine messaging, positioning, and outreach approaches. Support sales teams with clear, usable materials that improve effectiveness in-market. Demand & Growth Support Collaborate with marketing teams on demand generation and growth initiatives. Support optimization of conversion funnels and lead acquisition efforts. Ensure messaging consistency across campaigns and channels. Measurement & Optimization Use analytics tools to measure the impact of marketing and GTM initiatives. Monitor performance and identify areas to improve effectiveness and efficiency. Apply insights to refine strategies and execution over time. What We’re Looking For Experience in product marketing, marketing, or product management, preferably in SaaS or B2B technology. knowledge and application of AI tools is a must have Experience supporting products across their lifecycle, from launch through adoption and growth. Comfort working with data and analytics to inform decisions and strategy. Ability to translate insights into clear messaging and actionable plans. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work closely with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment. Experience in rewards, incentives, loyalty, and fintech will be a big plus. Nice to Have Experience working with or marketing to the US market. Hands-on experience with analytics, advertising, or CRM tools. What Makes You a Strong Fit You’re curious about customers and markets and actively seek out insights. You’re comfortable balancing strategy with hands-on execution. You communicate clearly and can align diverse stakeholders around a shared narrative. You’re organized, adaptable, and able to move work forward in ambiguous situations. Why This Role Matters This role helps ensure our products are clearly understood, effectively positioned, and supported in the market. By connecting customer insight, product strategy, and sales execution, you’ll directly influence adoption, revenue growth, and how our products show up for customers. Why Join Us Work closely with product, sales, and marketing leaders. Have direct ownership over key go-to-market initiatives. Build skills across positioning, enablement, and growth. Operate in a collaborative, execution-focused environment. Contribute to products used by businesses globally.
title: Product Marketing Manager

description: We're at a pivotal moment for both Tibber and the planet. When joining Tibber, you won’t just help scale a forward-thinking tech company – you’ll contribute to a real shift in how people consume electricity. With millions of smart devices connected to the Tibber platform (like electric vehicles and smart thermostats), we have one of the most unique energy trading portfolios on the market. We’re looking for a Product Manager to join us in making the energy transition happen – maybe that’s you? Job Mission 🚀 As a Product Manager for Energy Market, you'll lead the foundational capabilities that make it possible for Tibber to deliver electricity to customers across four markets, from supplier switching and metering data ingestion to market integrations and delivery lifecycle management. This role sits behind many customer-facing experiences. Your impact is measured in processes that work, markets that scale, and engineering teams that can move faster because someone understands the domain well enough to lead, not just coordinate. What You'll Do ✅ Lead/own the product roadmap and delivery for foundational electricity-delivery capabilities — market integrations, supplier switching, metering data ingestion, and delivery lifecycle management Drive improvements to conversion and completion rates across onboarding and activation flows, reducing drop-off and failure rates as new signups move through market processes Work closely with the Energy Contract PM to maintain clean boundaries between foundational delivery and commercial contract logic Contribute to building AI-assisted solutions that reduce manual back-office work and help the team identify and prioritize the right problems faster What We're Looking For⚡ You're energized by bringing clarity to complex domains — comfortable navigating regulated environments where success depends on understanding how external actors, systems, and processes interact. We Believe You'll Thrive Here If You: Have proven experience as a PM in a complex, regulated, multi-actor operational domain - energy, logistics, telecom, payments, or similar Can independently map actor relationships, information flows, and regulatory constraints without leaning on engineering to explain the domain Use data to identify where processes break down and drive measurable improvements — whether that's failure rates, completion rates, or operational efficiency Are comfortable working with backend systems and APIs as part of your daily work Communicate proactively — you surface blockers, share context, and keep stakeholders aligned without being prompted; especially important in a distributed team where some engineers are in Berlin and others are not Tibber is becoming more AI-enabled and we embrace new tools and ways of working. You don't need to be an expert, but we believe you are motivated by that and excited to grow with it too 💆🏻 ♀️💆🏽 ♂️The Tibber Mindset Tibber exists to drive energy independence – away from fossil dependency. Our tech helps hundreds of thousands of households shift their electricity consumption to more sustainable and affordable hours, strengthening the resilience of the grid. Not in theory. In everyday life. Being on a mission to change an industry means being prepared for the unexpected. We do what others say can't be done – and we do it together. We win, fail and grow together, staying curious and pushing for better - every day. AI is shaping how we work - and we believe it's how we accelerate the energy transition. The more it becomes part of how we operate, the more our Tibberinos matter. Started by two founders in 2016. Now 300+ Tibberinos across Stockholm, Berlin, Amsterdam, Oslo and Førde. Backed by Balderton Capital, Eight Roads Ventures, Founders Fund, Summa and Schibsted. Still just getting started. Diversity of thought fuels better products. We welcome applicants of every background, identity and lived experience. Ready to be part of powering the energy transition? Apply below!
title: Product Manager - Energy Market

description: About the role We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to turn compelling narratives and hypotheses into measurable go-to-market activities: attracting technical professionals and buyers, and driving adoption of Computer across self-serve and enterprise audiences. You'll define how a product area is positioned and brought to market, own the go-to-market strategy, and execute it across segments. We expect you to build the engine while staying deeply in the work, writing the messaging, running the launch, and reading the results yourself. What you'll do Lead go-to-market strategy and execution for launches and feature releases, owning the launch plan, ICP, value drivers, and coordination with product, design, sales, and demand gen. Define positioning, messaging, and differentiation across segments, from solo sign-ups to enterprise buyers. Build a measurement framework that gives clear visibility into expected outcomes and lets you track traction continuously: pipeline, sign-ups, activation, adoption, win rate. Own the competitive narrative for your area (against horizontal AI, legacy CX/EX tools, and build-it-yourself alternatives), translated into battlecards and objection handling the field can use. Partner with product and engineering to shape roadmap priorities through customer and competitive insight, and close the loop by feeding named asks from win/loss and customer calls back to leadership. Support sales enablement with pitch narratives, competitive messaging, demos with objection handling, and case studies. A clear, sharp writer. You can explain a complex feature in a subject line and hold a room with the strategy behind it. Strong at positioning: you look at a segment and a product moment and know which story will land, and you bring a point of view, not just execution against a brief. An experimenter. You develop and test hypotheses on channels, messaging, and value propositions, treat every launch as a test with a clear outcome you can read, and iterate fast. Someone who dives deep on the numbers. You track the KPIs that matter, understand what's moving and why, and turn the insight into the next action, not a deck that sits in a drive. Biased toward shipping and iterating quickly over long planning cycles. Able to build cross-functional trust and manage senior stakeholders without formal authority. You get energy from building from scratch, and have a hacker mentality. What you'll bring 5+ years in product marketing, growth, or developer marketing for a technical or enterprise audience. A track record of customer-facing content, campaigns, or messaging you can speak to in detail and tie to measurable outcomes. Experience owning end-to-end product launches and marketing campaigns. Comfort with analytics, CRM, and marketing automation tools (e.g., HubSpot) to drive decisions. Strong cross-functional collaboration, prioritization, and program management. Background in, or strong interest in, AI-powered products. What sets you apart You use gen AI tools daily and ship content with them. You're in every new model the week it drops. Experience with A/B testing and customer research methodologies. A track record of leading successful product launches across multiple markets or segments. Experience working in matrixed, cross-functional organizations. Familiarity with product analytics, CRM, and marketing automation platforms.
title: Product Marketing Manager

description: Job Type: Permanent - Full Time Location: Dublin, Ireland Job Category: IT Job Description Where will your career take you next? Let’s find out together. At Zurich Cover-More, we’re proud to be one of the world’s leading travel insurance and assistance providers . Each year, we protect more than 20 million travellers worldwide, making sure we’re there every step of their journey with proactive care, personalised cover and specialist support. Zurich Cover-More partners with many of the world’s best-known brands – think major airlines, travel giants, top banks, credit card providers, and large retailers – to deliver more care, more cover, for all. Launched in December 2024, Zurich Cover-More is the global travel brand of Zurich Insurance Group, one of the world’s leading multi-line insurers. Our family of customer-facing brands includes trusted names like Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely, and Blue Insurance. Together, we’re redefining what it means to travel safely and with confidence. Whether it’s a long-awaited holiday, a last-minute business trip, or an unexpected detour, we deliver in the moments that matter. What You’ll Be Doing As a Data Business Analyst, you’ll play a key role in translating business objectives into clear, actionable data, reporting and dashboard requirements. Working closely with product, operational, commercial and technology teams, you'll help shape trusted data solutions that drive better decision-making and business performance. Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand reporting, analytics and data requirements. Facilitate workshops and discussions to gather, challenge and refine business needs. Translate complex business questions into structured requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. Define KPIs, business rules, data definitions and reporting logic to support decision-making. Produce documentation including process maps, data dictionaries, data flows and dashboard specifications. Collaborate with BI developers, data engineers and technology teams to deliver data and reporting solutions. Support the design and development of dashboards and reports by defining measures, calculations and business outcomes. Validate reporting outputs to ensure accuracy, quality and alignment to business requirements. Promote good data governance practices, including data ownership, quality standards and lineage documentation. Support product teams by identifying insights that improve customer journeys, operational performance and commercial outcomes. Drive adoption of new reporting tools and processes through stakeholder engagement, training and communication. Identify opportunities to improve reporting, analytics, data quality and business analysis practices. What skills and experience you’ll bring on this journey: Proven experience as a Business Analyst, ideally within data, reporting, analytics, business intelligence or data governance environments. Strong ability to translate business requirements into user stories, functional specifications and acceptance criteria. Experience defining and delivering reporting, dashboard or data-driven solutions that support business decision-making. Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong understanding of data management principles, including data quality, metadata, lineage and governance frameworks. Experience creating process maps, data flows, data dictionaries and business documentation. Hands-on experience using tools such as Excel, Power BI, Visio and data documentation platforms. Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail and the ability to structure and solve complex problems. Knowledge of data privacy, regulatory and compliance requirements, including GDPR. Experience working within regulated or complex business environments would be advantageous, as would exposure to enterprise governance tools such as Informatica and relevant BA or data certifications. Why you’ll love working with us! We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability, results-orientation, and forward-thinking. We have more than 3000 employees worldwide. We are a global group of digital specialists, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts, customer service and corporate services professionals. We share a global purpose to look after travellers, at every step of their journey. Job flexibility . We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid approach ensures you can maintain work-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home after an initial training period. Career growth . This is an extremely exciting time for us at Zurich Cover-More, as we rapidly expand our business across the globe. We’re committed to helping our people thrive through a comprehensive onboarding experience, continuous professional development, and a supportive work environment that empowers growth at every stage of your career. Take the time you need, for you and your community . We encourage you to take the time you need when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme. Travel and work with us. We believe your career should take you places – literally. At Zurich Cover-More, we support your professional journey and your passion for travel with complimentary travel insurance. So go ahead, start planning your next adventure today! Investing in your health and your future. We offer a competitive health insurance package with comprehensive mental health coverage, access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and a pension scheme with employer contributions – helping you build a secure and healthy future. Diversity and inclusion . We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. Wherever life has taken you, we welcome you to bring your whole self to work. Just be you – because that’s exactly who we’re looking for. Apply today and let’s go to great places together! At Zurich Cover-More, compensation for roles is influenced by a variety of factors, including but not limited to office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. We are committed to providing a fair and reasonable compensation range for each role and additional rewards may include short-term incentive bonuses and increases based on merit. If your salary expectations are not in line with the proposed salary published for this role, you are still encouraged to apply. We will consider applications from talented individuals with the relevant experience, skills, education and attitude on a case-by-case basis. The compensation shown reflects a national market range and the proposed salary for this position is £53,015 - £62,371 / €57,851 - €68,061 with short-term incentive bonus eligibility of 10%.

description: Description Are you customer centric, smart and analytical, strategic yet execution focused, entrepreneurial, and passionate about protecting brands? Do you want to be part of one of the fastest growing and most innovative brand protection businesses? Are you interested in a high impact, high ownership role that sits at the intersection of product authenticity, brand trust, and customer confidence? If yes, this opportunity will appeal to you. Come join our team and help define the course of Amazon's product authenticity and brand protection business. Amazon's vision is to be Earth's most customer-centric company and the most trusted place for brands to grow and protect their business. We build programs and solutions that help brand owners verify product authenticity, secure their supply chain through serialization, and build customer trust — delighting millions of brands and customers every day. We are looking for a smart, metrics and results-oriented Product Marketing Manager to independently own our most important brand-facing product authenticity initiatives — the "big rocks" that move the business. You will set the go-to-market and adoption roadmap for our product authenticity and serialization programs, build and scale marketing campaigns across the funnel, and define the dashboards and mechanisms that track enrollment, adoption, engagement, and retention. Key job responsibilities Owning and driving the biggest, product marketing initiatives for brand protection and authenticity programs end to end — from strategy through execution and measurable business impact. Designing and scaling account-based marketing (ABM) programs that target high-value brands and segments with tailored, high-touch messaging around supply chain integrity and anti-counterfeiting solutions. Owning the full marketing funnel — awareness, lead generation, enrollment, activation, and retention — and independently driving conversion improvements at each stage. Building and scaling lifecycle and nurture programs (email, social, webinars, outbound, onboarding journeys) that move brands from awareness to active adoption of authenticity solutions. Leading go-to-market strategy for major new feature and program launches, including positioning, messaging, segmentation, and cross-program placements. Defining the metrics, dashboards, and mechanisms used to measure program health (enrollment rates, serialization adoption, scan rates, brand engagement), and reporting performance and recommendations to senior leadership. Developing content and thought-leadership strategies (case studies, playbooks, webinars, brand-facing events) that drive awareness and enrollment at scale for product authenticity programs. Establishing best practices and reusable playbooks, and mentoring peers and junior team members to raise the bar across the org. Basic Qualifications 3+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables) Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional programs or marketing campaigns from concept to completion Experience producing marketing promotional material for Owned & Operated channels Experience in brand identity and voice development Experience creating brand marketing content Preferred Qualifications Experience using customer research, hard data and metrics to back up assumptions, generate forecasts, and assess the efficacy of marketing programs Experience utilizing systems and tools involving email, web, analytics, and CRM (Marketo, Tableau, Salesforce, etc.) for targeting, segmentation, reporting for demand generation Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. description: Présentation de la société Depuis 2021, Team.is accompagne les startups, scale-ups et entreprises innovantes, industries de pointe et entreprises de services dans leurs recrutements les plus stratégiques, en France comme à l'international. AI, GenAI, DeepTech, Tech, Gaming, Industrie ou fonctions Business critiques : nous identifions et attirons les talents capables d'accélérer la croissance, l'innovation et l'exécution. Grâce à une approche AI-powered , une connaissance approfondie des marchés et une expertise en headhunting, nous relevons les défis de recrutement les plus complexes et les plus pénuriques. Description En postulant à cette offre, vous aurez l'opportunité de rejoindre une fintech européenne qui conçoit et distribue des produits structurés, et qui édite la plateforme logicielle couvrant l'ensemble de leur cycle d'investissement : pricing multi-émetteurs, gestion des collectes, suivi de portefeuille, reporting. Utilisée chaque jour par les équipes internes comme par les distributeurs clients, cette plateforme a vocation à devenir l'infrastructure de référence des produits structurés en Europe, puis à l'international. Elle entre dans un programme de développement de plusieurs années : de nouveaux modules à concevoir, à éprouver avec des utilisateurs pilotes et à mener jusqu'à la mise en production. L'entreprise est régulée en tant que prestataire de services d'investissement. Le poste est une création : c'est le premier Product Owner - Product Manager de la société. Rattaché(e) au Chief Product Officer et installé(e) au cœur d'une équipe technique de sept personnes — CTO, développeurs, QA — dans une organisation courte où les décisions se prennent vite, vous tenez les deux moitiés du rôle — l'exécution et le produit. Vous construisez la roadmap avec le CPO, vous êtes garant(e) de ce qui est livré, et vous faites progresser la méthode de travail de l'équipe de développement au quotidien. Vos six premiers mois : reprendre l'expression du besoin et structurer le backlog, aller à la rencontre des utilisateurs, et préparer l'ouverture de la plateforme à de nouveaux segments de clientèle. Vos missions si vous les acceptez Cadrage et priorisation — qualifier et prioriser les demandes entrantes, arbitrer, tenir le backlog. Spécification — rédiger des tickets clairs, directement exploitables par la technique. Animation — préparer et animer les cérémonies, diriger le grooming avec l'équipe de développement. Discovery et mesure de l'usage — recueillir les besoins en amont, mesurer l'utilisation réelle de ce qui est livré. Validation — valider chaque mise en production avec la QA. Documentation — formaliser les décisions produit et en assurer la traçabilité. Exigences Et vous ? Vous disposez de 5 à 8 ans d'expérience, dont une expérience significative en Product Owner ou en Product Manager. Vous avez exercé en start-up ou en scale-up ; un parcours en grand groupe convient si vous êtes passé(e) récemment en environnement start-up. Vous avez développé des processus produit, à la fois en project manager et en product manager, au sein d'une organisation produit mature. Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme de niveau Bac +3 minimum. Vous travaillez au quotidien avec des équipes de développement et vous comprenez bien leurs contraintes techniques. Vous savez défendre une priorisation face à des interlocuteurs expérimentés. Vous voulez tenir les deux moitiés du rôle, l'exécution et le produit. Vous êtes de langue française courante et vous pratiquez l'anglais professionnel : l'équipe est francophone, les clients anglophones. Une appétence pour la finance de marché est un plus ; l'expertise des produits structurés s'acquiert en interne. Avantages Il en faut plus pour vous convaincre ? Une création de poste : vous êtes le premier PO-PM de la société et vous installez la fonction produit. Un programme produit de plusieurs années, avec de nouveaux modules à concevoir de bout en bout. Une équipe technique de sept personnes, où les décisions se prennent vite et où l'on accède directement aux fondateurs. Un poste basé à Luxembourg, au cœur d'un écosystème financier européen. Un processus de recrutement court et lisible : un échange avec le Chief Product Officer, un entretien avec l'équipe, puis une rencontre avec les fondateurs.
title: Product Owner / Product Manager - H/F

description: Wil jij… Zelfstandig de marketingstrategie voor de Nederlandse markt bepalen en uitbouwen? Data, AI en marketinginzichten vertalen naar campagnes die aantoonbaar bijdragen aan pipeline en omzet? Niet alleen bestaande marketingactiviteiten onderhouden, maar juist nieuwe demand creëren en de markt actief ontwikkelen? De vrijheid krijgen om een visie neer te zetten, deze te vertalen naar een concrete marketingplanning en hem vervolgens zelf uit te voeren? Nauw samenwerken met sales en internationale marketingteams om het merk in Nederland verder op de kaart te zetten? Ja? Dan is dit jouw nieuwe baan! De organisatie Jouw nieuwe werkgever is een internationale organisatie binnen de financiële dienstverlening, gespecialiseerd in investeringen in commercieel vastgoed. Vanuit verschillende Europese markten wordt een brede vastgoedportefeuille opgebouwd en beheerd. De organisatie heeft een sterke internationale ambitie en wil haar positie op de Nederlandse markt de komende jaren verder uitbouwen. Nederland is daarbij een markt met een eigen dynamiek en vraagt om een duidelijke lokale marketingaanpak. Je wordt onderdeel van een internationale marketingorganisatie, waarbij je nauw samenwerkt met collega's uit onder andere Frankrijk. Tegelijkertijd krijg je juist de verantwoordelijkheid om te bepalen wat er in Nederland nodig is: van positionering en demand generation tot campagnes, events en PR. Jouw nieuwe baan: Als Demand Generation Manager ben jij dé marketingverantwoordelijke voor de Nederlandse markt. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de CMO en krijgt veel vrijheid om een visie en strategie voor Nederland neer te zetten. Je vertaalt deze naar een concrete planning, bepaalt welke campagnes en initiatieven nodig zijn en zorgt vervolgens ook zelf dat deze worden uitgevoerd. In het begin kun je rekenen op ondersteuning vanuit het internationale team, maar uiteindelijk ben jij degene die zelfstandig de kar trekt. Je belangrijkste doel is het creëren van nieuwe demand en het ondersteunen van sales met kwalitatieve leads en pipeline. Je ontwikkelt nieuwe e-mailcampagnes en nurturing flows, zet geïntegreerde campagnes op en organiseert events zoals roundtables, webinars, beurzen en partner-events. Ook kijk je continu naar de positionering van het merk in Nederland: hoe zorgen we dat de organisatie zichtbaar is bij de juiste doelgroep en hoe bouwen we vanuit marketing aan een sterke marktpositie? Daarnaast stuur je waar nodig externe partners aan, bijvoorbeeld een PR-bureau, en vertaal je internationale campagnes en initiatieven naar wat werkt voor de Nederlandse markt. Data en technologie spelen een belangrijke rol in je aanpak. Je begrijpt marketingdata, weet welke KPI's relevant zijn en kunt inzichten vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen in campagnes. Je gebruikt AI en andere tools om slimmer en efficiënter te werken en bent continu bezig met testen, leren en optimaliseren. Je kijkt dus niet alleen naar open rates, clicks of bereik, maar vooral naar de vraag: wat levert deze campagne uiteindelijk op voor sales? Er staat al een marketingbasis waarop je kunt voortbouwen, maar jouw opdracht is vooral om deze verder uit te bouwen, nieuwe initiatieven te ontwikkelen en een schaalbare, meetbare demand generation-aanpak neer te zetten. Paid acquisition is onderdeel van de rol, maar geen vereiste om alles zelf uit te voeren. Je werkt hierbij samen met een lokale freelancer en bent vooral verantwoordelijk voor de strategie, aansturing en resultaten. Ervaring met LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads en andere relevante kanalen is daarom een mooie pré. description: Available Position: Business Intelligence Manager Division: Communications Division Grade: Higher Executive Officer (HEO) Employing Authority: Competition and Consumer Protection Commission (CCPC) Location: Office in Dublin 1/ Agile (Hybrid) working available Closing date: 09 October 2026 Starting Salary: €60,029 Division Overview The Communications and Consumer Information Division is a large and dynamic division in the CCPC structured into two pillars of work. The Communications pillar consists of two units and is overseen by a Deputy Director. It is responsible for positioning the CCPC as the leading voice in promoting open and competitive markets and representing the interests of consumers. This includes actively increasing public awareness of the CCPC, influencing public policy debates on priority issues and promoting consumer rights through media and marketing campaigns. The Consumer Information pillar, in which the Business Intelligence Manager role will be based, consists of two units and is overseen by a Deputy Director. It is responsible for delivering insightful, accessible and expert information services that empower consumers to resolve routine problems. In turn, consumer engagements are analysed and insights shared with colleagues working in the Communications pillar, the CCPC’s enforcement divisions and the CCPC’s Research, Advocacy and International division. The two units in the pillar are: Contacts and Analysis Unit Actively manages an outsourced contact centre providing phone, email and other communications channels support to c. 45,000 consumers p/a. Provides on-call expert support for helpline agents and consumer rights and personal finance topics. Undertakes ongoing maintenance and development of Microsoft Dynamics CRM. Assesses and routes reports to CCPC enforcement divisions for screening. Analyses and reports on consumer contacts. Website and Digital Content Unit Actively manages the suite of CCPC websites, providing current, accurate information resources to consumers and businesses while also showcasing the work of the CCPC. Provides a range of digital personal finance comparison tools and calculators to support consumers in financial decision-making. Works on a cross-functional basis and with external agencies to deliver an ongoing series of innovative web development projects to enhance the CCPC digital offering to the public. Publishes the CCPC’s monthly consumer newsletter. Role The CCPC is seeking to recruit a Business Intelligence Manager, at Higher Executive Officer (HEO) grade, reporting to the Head of Unit, at Assistant Principal (AP) grade within the Contacts & Analysis Unit. The Business Intelligence Manager will work within the Contacts & Analysis Unit and support the work of the wider Communications division by applying strong analytical, reporting and presentation skills. The role will provide ongoing product and project management, as well as strategic insights to support evidence-based decision-making across the organisation. The CCPC publishes bi-annual reports on helpline contacts, which are available on ccpc.ie. A significant part of this role will involve detailed analysis and interpretation of all helpline contacts to inform these reports as well as the management of information across the division from multiple sources, including onward referral of market data received by the CCPC to enforcement teams. Another critical aspect of this role will involve assessing the impact of existing and new legislation to ensure a full understanding of how it affects the helpline teams and developing processes and digital tools that enable an enhanced and more efficient service offering. The Successful Candidate: This is an exciting opportunity for a manager with the relevant experience to help drive the CCPC’s strategy and empower consumers to achieve positive outcomes in disputes with traders. The successful candidate will be a strategic and consumer-focused Business Intelligence Manager with a proven ability to translate user needs, data insights and organisational objectives into impactful product outcomes, driving continuous improvement and stakeholder value. The ideal candidate will have experience working in public information and/or other regulated industries. They will be adept at reviewing and interpreting consumer insight data across multiple channels and sources. They will possess high levels of project management skills, service design, risk management and data analysis/ reporting capabilities. They will be familiar with data quality management, case management and/or CRM systems and use this knowledge to extrapolate data to provide insights and recommendations to the wider CCPC organisation. They will demonstrate exceptional communication skills and be an effective relationship builder, working closely with colleagues across the CCPC. The successful candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of working in a fast-paced environment. They will have a strong focus on continuous improvement and delivering against workplans. Key Responsibilities Reporting & Analysis Develop, maintain and enhance management information dashboards and operational and strategic performance reports, ensuring data is accurate, timely, consistent and effectively presented. Lead on data quality, governance and best practice, including monitoring Dataverse capacity, storage utilisation and data growth trends, and supporting data archiving and retention in line with organisational, governance and regulatory requirements. Analyse large and complex datasets, including contact data, to identify trends, risks, opportunities and emerging consumer issues, and translate findings into actionable recommendations for stakeholders. Deliver ad-hoc analysis, support business cases, strategic reviews and planning exercises, and identify opportunities to improve services, operational efficiency, resource use and data-driven decision-making. Product and Project Management Develop and manage project plans, including scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines, resources and budgets, ensuring delivery on time, within budget and to the required quality standards. Identify, assess and manage project risks, issues and dependencies, developing mitigation strategies, escalating concerns where necessary, and reporting accurately on project status, performance and outcomes. Gather, analyse and prioritise business and user requirements, maintain the product roadmap, and act as business lead for Contacts & Analysis systems, working with Digital Solutions, ICT units and external suppliers to deliver effective digital solutions. Build and manage relationships with project sponsors, business owners, team members and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, effective engagement, expectation management and regular progress reporting. Ensure adherence to organisational governance frameworks, project management methodologies and relevant policies, support communication, training and adoption activities, and identify opportunities to use emerging technologies, analytics and AI-enabled capabilities to improve service delivery, efficiency and consumer insights.
title: Business Intelligence Manager

description: Als Financieel Strategisch Analist vertaal je cijfers naar strategische keuzes die het verschil maken. Je hebt een interne adviesrol waarbij je niet alleen maar bezig bent in Excel, maar ook al je stakeholders meekrijgt in je verhaal en ze overtuigt van jouw analyses. Je werkt samen met de directie, operatie en andere teams om met jouw inzichten Coolblue elke dag een beetje beter te maken. Je denkt analytisch en gestructureerd, presenteert overtuigend en neemt met gemak de leiding in strategische projecten. Wat doe je als Financieel Strategisch Analist bij Coolblue? Als Financieel Strategisch Analist ben je van begin tot eind betrokken bij grote strategische projecten. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor de financiële forecasting voor heel Coolblue. Je werkt nauw samen met de Directie en Head of Control. Je duikt in de cijfers, trekt heldere conclusies en vertelt het verhaal achter de getallen. Jij zorgt als eigenaar van jouw projecten dat goede ideeën niet op papier blijven staan, maar worden vertaald naar concrete acties. Ondertussen leer je veel van én met je teamgenoten – andere Financieel Strategisch Analisten – en zorg je ervoor dat jij én Coolblue elke dag een beetje beter worden. Je Houdt Je Onder Andere Bezig Met Het maken van strategische analyses die echt impact hebben op het resultaat van Coolblue. Je staat niet aan de zijlijn, maar werkt samen met interne stakeholders om een zo goed mogelijk advies te geven. Het uitwerken van business cases rond thema’s als operationele efficiëntie, logistiek, nieuwe proposities of ESG. Het vertalen van je adviezen naar heldere actieplannen, voor directie en teams. Zorgen voor voortgang op projecten, waarbij jij het voortouw neemt en anderen meeneemt in je verhaal. Samenwerken met gedreven collega’s die net zo ambitieus zijn als jij. Hier herken jij jezelf in Een WO-bachelor en masterdiploma in bijvoorbeeld Business Economics, Finance, Quantitative Finance, Strategic Management, (Technische) Bedrijfskunde, CEMS, Data Science, Business Analytics. Relevante stage- of werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld in consultancy of finance. Extracurriculaire ervaring is een pré. Passie voor cijfers en het vermogen die te vertalen naar praktische strategie. Sterk in Excel of Sheets, én sterk in het overtuigend overbrengen van je verhaal, met en zonder slides. Een proactieve houding waarmee je continu zoekt naar verbetering. Beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift. Dit zoek jij verder in een baan Geld. Ongekend goede werksfeer. Waar we met elkaar omgaan als vrienden en je gewoon jezelf kan zijn. Maandelijkse borrels, versbereide happen, legendarische Coolblue-feesten en de leukste teamactiviteiten. Alle ruimte voor jouw eigen ideeën, initiatieven en keuzes. Jij doet je werk op jouw manier. Reiskostenvergoeding, pensioenregeling en 25 vakantiedagen. Als je belooft dat je terugkomt. Een kantoor waar je foto's van wilt maken op een toplocatie. Vanaf Rotterdam Centraal is het 3 keer vallen voor je er bent. Oké, het is 2 minuten lopen. Meer dan 100 trainingen in onze eigen Studiefabriek om elke dag een beetje beter te worden. Korting op alle spullen die we verkopen.
